transcript:
Okay, so I just got off the call with Majdi and there was a lot
covered So let me try to get all of this down while it's fresh So first
thing the blood results from two weeks ago came back and most things
look fine But he flagged the fasting insulin, which was 11.2 He said
it's within range technically but on the higher end and he wants to keep
an eye on it Fasting glucose was 88, which he was happy with Ferritin
came back at 24, better than last time, which was 18 So the iron
supplementation is working he said to keep going with it, but maybe drop
from twice a day to once a day now and The creatinine was 1.1, which dr.
Hoffman was worried about but Majdi said That's completely fine for
someone my size doing strength training He's not concerned. The other
thing Majdi said is he wants me to add tudka to the stack 250 milligram
with the evening meal because of the berberine load and the liver over
time He also mentioned Actually, I should look this up something about
cycling the berberine like doing eight weeks on Two weeks off starting
from next month and then this is separate He said to keep an eye on the
cortisol and that if the anxiety doesn't improve in the next few weeks
We should look at four-point cortisol test. I need to book that if it
comes to it Also, he said the reason I might be waking at 3 or 4 a.m.
Could be blood sugar related early morning hypoglycemia, so he suggested
Having a small protein snack before bed. I'm going to try a cottage
cheese. That's apparently a classic for this Oh and one more thing he
said Don't worry about the Lion's Mane He is fine with me continuing it
but to monitor for any digestive changes in the first few weeks
